conversion_conventions.shift: E_i f(n)=f(n+unit_i). Q denotes q^n multiplication, EQ=qQE. Source backward q recurrences are shifted to zero-based forward E coordinates.
conversion_conventions.coefficient_monomials: Total degree, preserving source prescribed support; source symmetry blocks use monomial-orbit sums.
conversion_conventions.leading_cones: A Cone term excludes all coefficient/shift monomials divisible by its exponent tuple.
conversion_conventions.exact_space_comparison: Full QQ row spaces, independent Sage finite-field rank lower bound plus exact known space residuals on fitting and independent heldout observations.
conversion_conventions.native_package_result: RISC Guess/qGeneratingFunctions were not run, loaded or activated; displayed mathematical outputs were independently re-expressed as exact sparse coefficient data.
